creation.title: Create character
creation.intro: Pick a race and background — base ability scores come from the background table. Roll your racial dice and enter the results as Correction.
creation.name: Name
creation.correctionOutOfRange: Correction is outside what the racial dice can roll: {{list}}
creation.rollsOwnSplit: This background rolls its own Skill/Body/Mind instead of listing fixed values — enter what you rolled.
creation.pointBuyHint: Optional (Epic Treasury p. 64): pick each value instead of rolling it. Every pick has a point cost shown next to it — the six Ability corrections must total 0 or less, and a rolled Skill/Body/Mind totals separately.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.abyssNoEquipment: Add a weapon, armor or a shield first.
sheet.abyssCorruptionWarning: 5 or more and the character fully Daemonizes, taken over by the GM (Abyss Breaker, p. 44).
sheet.noClasses: No classes yet — this character has not spent experience on one.
sheet.noMagicSchools: No Wizard-type class — this character casts nothing.
sheet.noCatalogForSchool: No catalog for this school yet — add spells by hand.
sheet.avatarError: That file could not be read as an image.
sheet.fellowIntro: Optional (Core Rulebook I, pp. 192-202): a simplified, damage-immune version of this PC for another play group to borrow as a guest NPC. Name, race, gender, age, level, MP and classes are read straight off the sheet above.
sheet.noFellowActions: No actions on the table yet — a Fellow can only do what is listed here.
sheet.noRiderClass: No Rider levels — only Horse, War Horse, Mini Manabike and Manabike can be ridden.
sheet.mountVariantsNote: Bought with reputation for +5 movement, no rental: {{names}}.
sheet.mountCatalogNote: {{count}} mounts from Core Rulebook III. A mount from another book is typed in by hand.
sheet.schoolsNote: Entry to a School and each of its Secrets is bought separately with Reputation (usually 50 to join, then each Secret's own cost) — the sheet does not track a Reputation budget, the same as every other Reputation purchase.
sheet.workSkillsIntro: Optional (Epic Treasury pp. 65-68, Raxia Life pp. 47-108): non-adventuring professions, used for out-of-combat checks. Guideline for a new PC: 5 levels per skill, 10 levels total — not enforced, a bookkeeping reminder. A level, once taken, is never lost.
